title: Junior Bookkeeper
body: We're looking for a junior bookkeeper to join our SME client team.
You'll maintain client ledgers, run reconciliations, and help with month-end.
Essential: hands-on experience with Sage 50 and comfort working in Outlook 365. Attention to detail and a tidy audit trail matter more to us than speed.

title: IT Support Technician
body: Support our small, busy office as a first-line IT technician, reporting to the IT Administrator.
Day to day you'll handle new-starter setup in Outlook 365, endpoint issues, and remote-access support.
Useful experience: administering Microsoft 365, supporting the NorthLink VPN client, and working alongside Sentinel-Guard endpoint protection. We'll train the right person on our specific setup.

title: Audit Associate
body: Join our audit team as an associate working across mid-market clients.
You'll perform testing, prepare working papers, and support seniors on fieldwork.
Part-qualified (or actively studying) with a solid grasp of double-entry and spreadsheets.

title: Tax Associate
body: We're expanding the tax practice and need an associate to prepare corporate and VAT returns.
You'll manage a filing calendar and liaise with clients for the records we need.
Experience with regional VAT and corporate filings is a plus.

title: Accounts Assistant (Payable/Receivable)
body: Support the accounts team across payable and receivable during a busy growth period.
You'll help with invoice intake, vendor onboarding checks, and reconciliations.
Comfort with Sage 50 and Outlook 365 is welcome; a methodical approach to matching invoices to purchase orders is essential.
